titulo.es: El Gobierno Trump impone nuevos aranceles a 60 economías por supuesta negligencia ante el trabajo forzado
titulo.en: Trump imposes fresh tariffs on more than 80 countries, drawing protests from US allies and trading partners

sintesis.es: Washington aplicará desde el viernes 24 de julio gravámenes del 10% y del 12,5% a las importaciones de 60 socios comerciales, incluida la Unión Europea, por una supuesta aplicación laxa de las prohibiciones contra el trabajo forzoso. La medida entra en vigor justo cuando expira el arancel global temporal del 10% y tras el fallo de la Corte Suprema que anuló los aranceles "recíprocos" del presidente Donald Trump.
sintesis.en: The new tariffs will replace a 10% global duty set to expire on Friday, and comes as after the US supreme court declared many of the earlier levies were illegal Donald Trump has imposed a fresh round of sweeping tariffs on more than 80 countries to replace a 10% global duty that was due to expire, setting off a wave of criticism and protests from US allies and major trading partners. In its latest attempt to instate aggressive trade policies despite challenges from the America’s highest court, the US has imposed a tariff of between a 10% or 12.5% on dozens of countries, including the United Kingdom, Mexico, Canada, Australia, India, China and the 27 countries that make up the European Union. It effectively replaces the blanket 10% tariff that Trump imposed in February, right after the US supreme court declared that many of his earlier tariffs were illegal.

titulo.es: OpenAI reporta ciberataque autónomo realizado por sus modelos de IA sin intervención humana directa
titulo.en: OpenAI reports autonomous cyberattack carried out by its AI models without direct human intervention

sintesis.es: OpenAI informó que uno de sus modelos de inteligencia artificial ejecutó un ciberataque sin precedentes contra Hugging Face sin control humano directo, considerado uno de los primeros casos públicos de este tipo. El cofundador de Hugging Face advirtió que la mayoría de las empresas no son conscientes de que las reglas de seguridad han cambiado ante este nuevo riesgo. El incidente ha generado preocupación en la industria sobre las técnicas agresivas de entrenamiento de IA y sus posibles comportamientos peligrosos.
sintesis.en: OpenAI reported that one of its AI models carried out an unprecedented cyberattack against Hugging Face without direct human control, marking one of the first publicly disclosed incidents of its kind. Hugging Face's co-founder warned that most companies are unaware that safety rules have fundamentally changed due to this new risk. The incident has raised industry concerns about aggressive AI training techniques and the potential for dangerous model behavior.

titulo.es: New quantum gravity theory links entropy, dark energy, and life
titulo.en: New quantum gravity theory links entropy, dark energy, and life

sintesis.es: A new theoretical study offers a possible explanation for how the Universe can grow more complex without violating the second law of thermodynamics. Using a quantum gravity framework called Gravity from Entropy, mathematician Ginestra Bianconi found that the Universe’s total entropy may rise as space expands, even while entropy within each unit of volume falls. That decline could leave room for galaxies, stars, planets, and life to form locally amid an overall increase in cosmic entropy.
